# HAL / CMSIS — generated by STM32CubeMX / CubeIDE

Open `../CountingMachine_G030.ioc` in **STM32CubeIDE** or **STM32CubeMX**:

1. Project → Generate Code (or CubMX: GENERATE CODE)
2. This folder fills with `CMSIS/` + `STM32G0xx_HAL_Driver/`
3. Build the project in CubeIDE

Do not commit the generated Drivers tree unless the team wants offline builds
without regenerating (see repo `.gitignore`).
